name: Dispatch
pitch: A ribbed mail capsule with a little forward lean. Built to get things there.
tradeoffs: The most literal connection to pneumatic mail, with sturdy condensed lettering and equipment-red controls. It feels purposeful before it feels decorative. The motion bars are supporting detail, not the identity; at small sizes the carrier’s ribs do the work. More industrial than cozy, and the red must remain a brand action color, not an error signal.
concept: Enamel-painted mailroom equipment, stamped destination labels, a carrier already on its way.
markNotes: A broad, ribbed tube carrier leans into its journey. Two short motion bars distinguish a mailroom object from a medicine capsule. One-color geometry; no lighting effects or fine outlines.
typeNotes: Barlow Condensed 600 has the compact authority of equipment lettering. Barlow 400 keeps notes and controls open and easy to scan. The wordmark is outlined; the UI specimens use the bundled fonts.
